name: NURS 5262
title: Advanced Integrative Clinical Concepts: Pathophysiology, Pharmacology, and Health Assessment
description: Designed to build upon existing nursing knowledge, skills, and attitudes, this course uses a body systems framework to explore advanced integrative clinical concepts in pathophysiology, pharmacology, and health assessment across the lifespan. Focus will be on common deviations from normal using a case study approach. This course is intended for MS students not planning to pursue nurse practitioner certification.
